newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends little changed, yen a key factor.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends little changed, yen a key factor.

text.p: The won ended nearly flat on Friday after dollar unwinding stemming from export deals alternated with dollar bargain hunting, dealers said.
"Dollar positions remained high. But there were fears of the central bank's dollar buying intervention," said a domestic bank dealer.
Dealers said the Japanese yen's future movement could dictate the won's direction.
The won closed at 889.30, compared with Thursday's close of 889.10 after fluctuating between 888.80 and 889.90.
The won's mid-rate is expected to be pegged at 889.20 on Monday, compared with 889.80 today, dealers said.
A Foreign bank dealer said he expected trading to range between 887.00 and 892.00 on Monday, while the domestic bank dealer put it 885.00-890.00.
